provenance.dataset_source: kaggle riotulab/skin-cancer-hair-removal v1, anonymous public download
provenance.method: frozen classical DullRazor (Arm B procedure) on the public DERMAHAIR pairs, CPU only
provenance.metric_note: psnr_up/ssim_up = upstream core.metrics at 128 px; sk = skimage at 128; 256 = output bicubic-upsampled vs the 256 px hairless image; LPIPS alex
